high_level_description: The image is a movie poster for the film "Officer." The poster features a man in a military uniform with his back to the viewer, looking over his shoulder towards the right side of the image. The title "OFFICER" is prominently displayed in large red letters across the center of the poster. Below the title, there is a subtitle that reads "ON DUTY," which is partially obscured by a group of people in the foreground. The group of people in the foreground appears to be engaged in some form of action or confrontation.
